title: site-quality config v1 (.github/site-quality.yml)
description: Caller config for the hub's reusable site-quality.yml workflow (Lighthouse CI, axe-core, pa11y contrast). Every threshold lives here: the workflow's own defaults only report and never fail. `version` and quoted dates follow .github/sdlc.yml. Unknown keys are rejected so typos fail loudly.

site.description: Where the site comes from. build mode reads source/build_command/site_dir; url mode reads base_url (the workflow's `base-url` input overrides it).

source.description: build mode: the Jekyll source directory, relative to the repo root. Default `.`.

build_command.description: build mode: a custom build that writes `site_dir`, run from `source`. Empty (default) = `bundle exec jekyll build` with remote_theme pinned to the resolved SHA. The command sees SITE_QUALITY_THEME_REPO, SITE_QUALITY_THEME_SHA and SITE_QUALITY_THEME_DIR (a fresh checkout of the theme at that SHA).

site_dir.description: build mode: the built site, relative to `source`. Default `_site`.

base_url.description: url mode: the live base URL that `pages` are joined to.

pages.description: Paths scanned, relative to the base (both modes). axe runs on all of them unless axe.pages narrows it.

viewports.description: axe viewports. Default: mobile-390 (390x844, mobile) and desktop-1366 (1366x768).

load_errors.description: Level of a page that does not load (navigation error or HTTP >= 400). Default warn.

runs.description: Runs per page; assertions use the median. Default 1.

public_upload.description: Also upload to LHCI temporary public storage (public link, ~7 days). Default false.

overrides.description: Per-page replacements for individual budget keys.

tags.description: axe rule tags to run. Default wcag2a, wcag2aa, wcag21a, wcag21aa, wcag22a, wcag22aa.

fail_on.description: A violation carrying one of `tags` with one of `impacts` is an error. Absent (default) = every violation is a warning.

max.description: Most contrast failures allowed before the page is an error. Absent = report-only.

hide_elements.description: CSS selector list hidden before measuring (e.g. gradient hero headings that htmlcs misreads as 1:1).

on_expired.description: What an entry past its `until` date does. warn (default, rollout) reports it and keeps it in force; error fails the run. The workflow input `expired-allowlist-level` overrides this.

date.description: Quoted "YYYY-MM-DD" (an unquoted YAML date is not a string and is rejected).

metrics.description: Maximum numeric values of metric audits (ms; unitless for cumulative-layout-shift), e.g. largest-contentful-paint, first-contentful-paint, total-blocking-time, cumulative-layout-shift.

audits.description: Must-pass audits (score 1), e.g. errors-in-console, unsized-images, label, button-name, link-name. `off` disables one inherited from the top level in an override.

sizes.description: Transfer-size budgets per resource type, in KiB.

rule.description: An axe rule id (button-name), a Lighthouse assertion id (unsized-images, categories:performance, resource-summary:total:size), `contrast` (pa11y), or `page-load`.

selector.description: Substring of the node's CSS selector path or HTML (axe, contrast).

page.description: A path, `*` for every page, or a prefix ending in `*` (e.g. /posts/*).

viewport.description: Limit an axe entry to one viewport name.

issue.description: Link to the issue that tracks the fix.
